name: EPOCHDAY
shortDescription: Number of days since the epoch
description: Extracts the number of days between 1970-01-01 and the given date or timestamp. Negative for dates before the epoch.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date to convert to a day count

examples.title: Days since the epoch
examples.description: Convert a timestamp to a day number
examples.sql: SELECT EPOCHDAY(created_at) as day_number FROM orders

examples.title: Group by day number
examples.sql:
SELECT EPOCHDAY(created_at) as day_number, COUNT(*) as n
FROM orders
GROUP BY EPOCHDAY(created_at)
